metadata.question: Was the cone of Mount Vesuvius, located 12 kilometers southeast of Naples, Italy, visible with Landsat 8 on January 2, 2022?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Collection: Landsat 8 Collection 2 Tier 1 Level-2 (LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2). Fallback: Landsat 8 TOA (LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_TOA).
- Date: 2022-01-02 to 2022-01-03 (exclusive).
- Location: Mount Vesuvius cone (Point at 14.4265E, 40.8214N) buffered by 1.2 km.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Yes, mask clouds, cloud shadow, cirrus, snow using QA_PIXEL; also mask saturated pixels using QA_RADSAT.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If no images: C1.
- If images exist but clear area or pixels after mask == 0: C2.
- If computed values are null/NaN or out of [0,1]: C3.
- Otherwise, visible if clear fraction >= 0.2; else not visible.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helpers
  const getInfoAsync = (eobj) =>
    new Promise((resolve, reject) => eobj.getInfo((res, err) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(res))));
  const safeNumber = (v) => (v === null || v === undefined ? null : Number(v));

  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const aoi = ee.Geometry.Point([14.4265, 40.8214]).buffer(1200); // ~Vesuvius cone
    const start = '2022-01-02';
    const end = '2022-01-03';
    const scale = 1000; // per best-practice guidance for reduceRegion performance
    const clearFracThreshold = 0.20;

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    let col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2')
      .filterBounds(aoi)
      .filterDate(start, end);
    let nL8L2 = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
    console.log(`AOI km2: ${((await getInfoAsync(ee.Number(aoi.area()).divide(1e6))) || 0).toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`Date: ${start}`);
    console.log(`L8 L2 Images: ${nL8L2}`);

    if (nL8L2 === 0) {
      // Fallback to L8 TOA
      let colTOA = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_TOA')
        .filterBounds(aoi)
        .filterDate(start, end);
      const nTOA = await getInfoAsync(colTOA.size());
      console.log(`L8 TOA Images: ${nTOA}`);
      if (nTOA === 0) {
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
      col = colTOA;
    }

    // 3. Processing
    const maskL8 = function (img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const radsat = img.select('QA_RADSAT');
      const mask = qa
        .bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0) // Cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)) // Cloud shadow
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0)) // Cirrus
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0)) // Snow
        .and(radsat.eq(0));
      return img.updateMask(mask);
    };

    // Choose best image by lowest scene cloud cover (if absent, first)
    let img = ee.Image(ee.Algorithms.If(col.size().gt(0), col.sort('CLOUD_COVER').first(), col.first()));
    const imgId = await getInfoAsync(img.id());
    const sceneCloud = await getInfoAsync(img.get('CLOUD_COVER'));
    console.log(`Best ID: ${imgId || 'n/a'}, SceneCloud: ${sceneCloud !== null ? sceneCloud : 'n/a'}`);

    // Select a common band present in both L2 and TOA (SR_B3 or B3)
    const bands = ee.List(img.bandNames());
    const bandName = ee.String(
      ee.Algorithms.If(
        bands.contains('SR_B3'),
        'SR_B3',
        ee.Algorithms.If(bands.contains('B3'), 'B3', bands.get(0))
      )
    );
    const base = img.select(bandName);
    const masked = maskL8(img).select(bandName);

    // Compute total/clear area and pixel counts within AOI
    const totalArea = ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(base.mask())
      .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true })
      .get('area');
    const clearArea = ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(masked.mask())
      .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true })
      .get('area');
    const totalCount = base.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true })
      .values().get(0);
    const clearCount = masked.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true })
      .values().get(0);

    const metrics = await getInfoAsync(ee.Dictionary({
      totalArea: totalArea, clearArea: clearArea, totalCount: totalCount, clearCount: clearCount
    }));

    const tArea = safeNumber(metrics.totalArea);
    const cArea = safeNumber(metrics.clearArea);
    const tCnt = safeNumber(metrics.totalCount);
    const cCnt = safeNumber(metrics.clearCount);

    // 4. Validation & Final Answer
    if (tArea === null || cArea === null || tCnt === null || cCnt === null) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    if (tArea <= 0 || tCnt <= 0) {
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    const clearFrac = cArea / tArea;
    if (!isFinite(clearFrac) || clearFrac < 0 || clearFrac > 1) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    const cloudPct = (1 - clearFrac) * 100.0;

    console.log(`TotalPx: ${tCnt}, ClearPx: ${cCnt}`);
    console.log(`TotalArea_km2: ${(tArea/1e6).toFixed(2)}, ClearArea_km2: ${(cArea/1e6).toFixed(2)}, ClearFrac: ${clearFrac.toFixed(2)}, Cloud%: ${cloudPct.toFixed(1)}`);

    // Visible if at least 20% of the cone area is cloud-free
    if (cArea <= 0 || cCnt <= 0) {
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    if (clearFrac >= clearFracThreshold) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error:', err && err.message ? err.message : err);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
